fields.distribution: Worldwide, most important in tropical and subtropical regions
fields.significance: Mainly a problem in nursing piglets, where heavy burdens cause diarrhoea, anaemia and wasting; light infections pass unnoticed.

lifecycleStages.name: egg
lifecycleStages.location: larvated when freshly passed in faeces

lifecycleStages.name: free-living adult
lifecycleStages.location: soil and bedding; males and females of a free-living generation

lifecycleStages.name: L3
lifecycleStages.location: soil or bedding; enters the pig through the skin

lifecycleStages.name: migrating L3
lifecycleStages.location: larvae reach the lungs after skin penetration; dormant larvae in the sow's udder pass to piglets in the milk

lifecycleStages.name: adult female
lifecycleStages.location: small intestine; females burrow into the lining beside the villus bases
